title: NFSMW Setup JSON-line event
description: One object per stdout line with --events. Child output goes only to the run log. --check ends after preflight, pc, x360 with exit 0 and no done event; --build emits done only after verified transactional install. Stages in order: preflight, pc, x360, recompile, tables, audio, shaders, ffmpeg, runtime, assets, bundle, install. Audio builds its FFmpeg prerequisite before compiling media.cpp. Cancellation exits 130; every other failed stage exits nonzero. work/run-log.txt contains the current log path. Environment overrides: NFSMW_SETUP_HOME (state/logs/cache/data beneath it), NFSMW_SETUP_STATE, NFSMW_SETUP_LOGS, NFSMW_SETUP_CACHE, NFSMW_SETUP_DATA, NFSMW_SETUP_LEGACY (the 3.x profile whose career saves install copies into a 4.0 profile without saves; warn event on copy or refusal). --check logs only in work/logs. setup.sh uses TOOLS_PY, else deps/python/bin/python3, python/bin/python3 or .venv/bin/python3 in the payload. Public bundle: NFS Most Wanted Native.app (executable NFSMostWanted; an existing 3.x app there is renamed NFS Most Wanted Native 3.x.app and kept); io.github.nfsmw-native-mac; version 4.0.0. --stage-only --dest <installed .app path> --stage <new directory> [--work <build directory>] --events builds and verifies the full app/data without installation, recovery, profile locks or save migration. Omitted --pc/--x360/--dest reuse state/source-choices.json, saved atomically after successful normal Setup; a remembered Xbox source is never implicitly dropped. Missing choices/source errors name SOURCE_CHOICES_MISSING, SOURCE_CHOICES_INVALID, X360_SOURCE_MISSING or X360_PREPARATION_MISSING in msg. Staging replaces the install stage with stage and ends with ready (never done). The descriptor path is absolute. ready.json format_version=1 contains version, app/data paths and roots relative to its directory, hashes.app/data (install.digest_tree), hashes.roots (SHA256 of relative roots.txt), destination (path, filesystem identity and content hash), profile and provenance (original source paths, input hashes, executable fingerprint, source inventory identity, dependencies and toolchain). All staged files/directories are fsynced before the atomic descriptor publication. A stage directory must be new, distinct from all protected paths; retry in a fresh directory. Consumers must revalidate hashes and destination identity before application. Staging never rewrites remembered choices. --work defaults to a sibling .<stage-name>-work directory. A successful stage retains its build work for retry; only ready.json signals readiness.
